Privacy Policy

Rituraj Singh Ratan operates Know Your Mind, a website for personal reflection. You can complete a check-in and view your report without an account.

Check-ins and reports

Know Your Mind calculates your report in your browser. Unfinished answers stay in the open page until you choose to save a draft; a saved draft then saves subsequent edits as you go. Completed reports and their answers save automatically in that browser and can be reopened from My reports. New reports do not automatically remove older ones. If browser storage is unavailable or full, the page explains that the report has not been saved. Know Your Mind uploads reports only when you choose an account save or opt in to auto-save new check-ins. Signing in alone does not sync browser-saved reports. Optional cloud saves are described below.

Anyone with access to the same browser profile may be able to open saved reports. You can delete individual reports from My reports, discard an unfinished check-in, or clear the site’s data in your browser. Signing out leaves those local saves in place. Know Your Mind also stores preferences such as your chosen language and may temporarily store where to return after sign-in.

Optional cloud reports and subscriptions

You can explicitly agree to cloud storage and choose a completed report to upload. You can separately opt in to auto-save future completed check-ins for this account in this browser, and turn that option off in My reports. The preference is stored in your browser. The selected answers are encrypted before storage in Cloudflare D1. The questionnaire version, language and check-in date are stored alongside them and linked to your Clerk account identifier. They are not copied into Clerk profile metadata, payment descriptions or payment-provider metadata. Cloud saves do not automatically upload other reports from your browser.

You can read or delete your account reports from My reports, and use Print / PDF from the report view to keep a downloaded copy. Account reports remain until you delete them or request their removal. Signing out clears account reports from the open app; it does not remove separate browser copies. Deleting a cloud report removes its live database record; earlier copies may remain in Cloudflare recovery snapshots for the provider's retention period. Deleting a local copy and deleting a cloud copy are separate actions. Previously saved cloud reports remain accessible after a subscription expires.

When subscriptions are enabled, Razorpay handles payment details. Know Your Mind stores subscription identifiers, payment references, billing periods and payment/refund status to manage access. It does not store your card details. Payment records are separate from questionnaire answers. Checkout remains unavailable until billing has been configured.

Feedback

The feedback form currently saves your name, email address, message and selected feedback type in this browser only. It does not send them to the Know Your Mind team or an email service. These notes remain on this device until the browser removes the site's data. Other people using the same browser profile may be able to access them. Please leave health details and report answers out of feedback.

Accounts and Google sign-in

Clerk processes your email address and account and session information to create your account, verify sign-ins and keep you signed in. It uses cookies and similar technology to manage authentication. When Google sign-in is available and you choose it, Google shares basic identity information with Clerk, such as your Google account identifier, email address, name and profile picture if provided. Know Your Mind uses this information to identify you and provide account access.

Know Your Mind requests only Google’s basic identity permissions. It does not request access to Gmail, Drive, contacts or calendars. Know Your Mind does not sell Google account data or use it for advertising. Its use of information received from Google APIs follows the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

New-account notifications

When signup alerts are enabled, a new account sends an operational notification to the Know Your Mind team's Slack channel. It includes your name if provided, verified primary email address, sign-in method, account identifier and signup time. Check-in answers, scores and reports are not included. These alerts help the team monitor account creation; ordinary sign-ins do not generate a new-account alert. Slack retains messages according to the workspace's retention settings. Contact us using the address below for account-data requests.

Optional site analytics

Google Analytics 4 is optional. It loads only after you choose Allow analytics on a public information page. It measures public-page visits with technical information such as browser and device information. We send a public page address and title without URL queries or fragments. We do not send your name, email, account identifier, check-in answers or report content, and analytics is disabled in the questionnaire, personal report and account-history views. Google Signals, advertising personalization and enhanced measurement are not enabled for this stream.

Analytics cookies are configured to expire after 60 days without automatic renewal. Use Analytics preferences in the footer to decline or withdraw consent; declining does not affect check-ins, sign-in or saving reports. Withdrawing stops measurement and removes this site's analytics cookies, but does not automatically erase data Google already received. Google describes its processing in the Google Privacy Policy.

Hosting and other service providers

Know Your Mind uses GitHub Pages for the earlier site and Cloudflare for its account-enabled deployment. When you load the earlier site, GitHub receives technical request information. On the current site, Cloudflare and services that deliver resources such as Google Fonts receive technical information such as your IP address and browser request details. Clerk and Google process authentication requests when their services are used. Cloudflare processes hosting and database requests on the cloud deployment. See the Cloudflare Privacy Policy and Slack Privacy Policy. Other providers describe their handling of technical information in the GitHub Privacy Statement, Clerk Privacy Policy and Google Privacy Policy.

Retention and your choices

Saved check-in data remains in your browser until you remove it or the browser clears it. Clerk stores account data so you can continue to sign in. You can contact Know Your Mind to request access to, correction of, or deletion of account information. Depending on where you live, you may have additional privacy rights. You can also revoke Know Your Mind’s access through your Google Account connections. Revoking access does not delete a Clerk account or local reports.

For privacy questions and account requests, email riturajratan@gmail.com. Please leave check-in answers and reports out of your message.
